questions.question: Chord AB and diameter CD of a circle meet at the point P, outside the circle when it is produced, If PB = 8 cm, AB = 12 cm and distance of P from the centre of the circle is 18 cm, the radius (in cm) of the circle is closest to: [√41 = 6.4]
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Secant Property

If chord AB and chord CD of a circle intersect at a point P, then

PA × PB = PC × PD

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5a037a05300d60c7c831cdbc1696d6d5fc671ea6225a2671b97e10f29bf2df.png] 

Let the radius of the circle = r 

PA = 12 + 8 = 20 cm, PB = 8 cm, PC = (18 + r) cm, PD = (18 - r) cm

PA × PB = PC × PD

⇒ 8 × 20 = (18 - r) × (18 + r)

⇒ 160 = 324 - r²

⇒ r² = 164

⇒ r = 12.8062 

**∴ The radius of the circle is closest to 12.8 cm**

questions.question: A car covers a distance of 48 km at a speed of 40 km/h and another 52 km with a speed of 65 km/h. What is the average speed of the car (in km/h) for the total distance covered?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed₁ = 40 km/h, Distance₁ = 48 km

Speed₂ = 65 km/h, Distance₂ = 52 km

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/ Speed 

Average Speed = Total Distance/ Total Time

**Calculation:**

Total Distance traveled = 48 km + 52 km

⇒ 100 km

Total Time = 48 km/ 40 km/h + 52 km/ 65 km/h 

⇒ 6/5 + 4/5 = 2 hours 

**Average Speed = 100 km/ 2 hours **

**∴ The required Speed = 50 km/h**

questions.question: What is the product of the largest and the smallest possible values of m for which a number 5m83m4m1 is divisible by 9 ?
questions.solution:
**Concept: **

Divisibility rule of 9: A number is divisible by 9, when the sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

5 + m + 8 + 3 + m + 4 + m + 1 

for minimum value 

⇒ 21 + 3m 

⇒ Minimum value of m = 2 (as 27 is the multiple of 9)

For maximum value 

⇒ 21 + 3m (as 45 is the multiple of 9)

⇒ Maximum value of m = 8

**∴ The product of largest and smallest value**

**⇒ 8 × 2 = 16**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 135°, CA = 5√2 cm and AB = 7 cm. E and F are midpoints of sides AC and AB, respectively. The length of EF (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB (c) = 7 cm, CA (b) = 5√2 cm, BC = a 

E and F are the mid-points of AC & AB.

∠A = 135°

**Concept:**

By cosine rule

Cos A = (b² + c² - a²)/ 2bc

Mid-point theorem

EF = BC/2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc218ac49806bd4bb4f42f9527b6479cf23bb8d94977b36d4aa1fc7edd686a2.png] 

According to the cosine rule

cos135⁰= ((5sqrt2)² + (7)² - (a)²)/(2×7×5sqrt2)

⇒ (-1)/(sqrt2)= ((5sqrt2)² + (7)² - (a)²)/(2×7×5sqrt2)

⇒ -70= 50 + 49 - a² 

⇒ a² = 169

⇒ a = 13, a ≠ - 13

⇒ BC = 13

From formula used

EF = BC/2 = 13/2 cm 

**∴ EF = 6.5 cm**

questions.question: A and B can complete a certain task in 24 days and 40 days, respectively. They worked together for 8 days. C completed the remaining task in 14 days. Working together, A and C will complete 75% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**1 day work of A and B = 1/24 + 1/40 = 8/120

8 day work of A and B = 64/120

Remaining work = 1 - 64/120 = 56/120

Work done by C in 14 days = 56/120

Work done by C in 1 day = 4/120 = 1/30

Work done by A and C = 1/24 + 1/30 = 9/120

Time taken = 120/9

Time taken by A and C to complete 75% work = 3/4 × 120/9 = 10 days

**Traditional method:**

**Given: **

No of days A takes = 24 

No of days B takes = 40

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 24 and 40 = 120 units

 Work Efficiency 

A 24 days 5 units

 120 units 

B 40 days 3 units

They work together for 8 days 

A + B = (5 + 3 ) × 8 = 64 units

Remaining work = 120 - 64 = 56 units 

C's efficiency = 56/14 = 4 units per day

No of days taken by A and C to do 75% of the work = 120/9 × 75/100

**∴ The required no of days = 10**

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 1,176 after two successive discounts of 30% and 16% on its list price. What is the difference (in Rs.) between the list price and the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs.1176

Discount₁ = 30%

Discount₂ = 16%

**Formula used:**

Discount = List Price – Selling Price

Selling price = List Price × (100 - D₁)/100 × (100 - D₂)/100 

**Calculation:**

Rs.1176 = LP × 70% × 84%

⇒ 1176 = LP × 70% × 84%

⇒ LP = 1176 × 100 × 100/ 70 × 84

⇒ LP = Rs.2000

**∴ The difference between LP and SP = 2000 - 1176**

**⇒ Rs.824**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Effective rate of discount = x + y ± xy/100⇒ 30 + 16 - 30 × 16/100 = 46 - 4.8 

⇒ 41.2%

List price = 1176 × 100/(100 - 41.2)

⇒ 100% = Rs.2000

LP - SP = 2000 - 1176 

**⇒ Rs.824**

questions.question: The altitude AD of a triangle ABC is 9 cm. If AB = 6√3 cm and CD = 3√3 cm, then what will be the measure of ∠A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**We know that the height of an equilateral triangle = a√3/2

Here, Height = 9 = 6√3 × √3/2 

a = 6√3, so Height = a√3/2.

∴ Given triangle is an equilateral triangle.

So, ∠A = 60°.

**Traditional method:**

**Concept:**

Pythagoras theorem:

(AB)² = (BD)² + (AD)²

Equilateral Triangle:

AB = BC = AC

∠A = ∠B = ∠C = 60°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72943c7a7cc57c87bf11f15066dd590009dc151a5656d00057d45a4297a06723.png] 

(6√3)² = (BD)² + 9²

⇒ BD = 3√3 cm 

∵ DC = BD = 3√3 cm

∴ BC = AC = AB = 6√3 cm &

**∠A = ∠B = ∠C = 60°**

**∴ ABC is an equilateral triangle.**

questions.question: Anamika paid Rs. 4,965 as compound interest on a loan of Rs. 15,000 after 3 years when compounded annually. Suman took a loan of Rs. 10,000 at the same rate on simple interest. How much interest did Suman pay after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anamika paid Rs. 4,965 as compound interest over 3 years

Principal for Anamika (loan of Anamika) = Rs. 15,000

Principal for Suman (loan of Suman) = Rs. 10,000 

Rate of interest of Anamika and Suman is similar

**Formula used: **

In the case of compound interest

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)³

Amount = Principal + C.I

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate × Time/100 

Amount = Principal + SI

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Amount paid by Anamika = 15000 + 4965 = 19965

So, 15000 × (1 + r/100)³ = 19965

⇒ (1 + r/100)3 = 19965/15000

⇒ (1 + r/100) = ∛ 19965/15000

⇒ (1 + r/100) = 11/10

⇒ r = 10%

Now, Again according to the question 

Rate of interest for Suman = 10%

Simple Interest paid by Suman = 10000 × 3 × 10/100 [Principal of Suman = 10000]

**∴ The required Interest paid by Suman is Rs.3000.**

questions.question: In ΔABC, AD is a median. If points E, F and G are midpoints of AD, AE and DE, respectively, then what will be the area ΔBFG ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD is the median of BC (BD = DC)

E is the mid-point of AD (AE = ED)

F is the mid-point of AE (AF = FE)

G is the mid-point of DE (EG = GD)

**Concept:**

The median of a triangle bisects the opposite side of a triangle and divides it into two equal parts of the area.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e773e71f0ef0c1901872c9b494f38e960f95de7fdea8e1fee669bbd4ab753761.png] 

Let the length of AD = 4 units 

∵ E, F, and G are the midpoints of AD, AE, and DE respectively.

∴ They divide the triangle ABD into 4 equal parts of the area.

Now, Area of triangle ABD = 1/2 × Area of triangle ABC (AD is the median)

⇒ 2 × Area of triangle BFG = 1/2 × Area of triangle ABC (AF = FE = EG = GD)

**∴ Area of triangle BFG = 1/4 × Area of triangle ABC.**

a² = a²/4 + (4√3)²

questions.question: A sum of money is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 7, respectively. If the share of B is Rs. 15,000, then what will be the difference in the shares of B and C ?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

A : B : C = 2 : 3 : 7

B's share = Rs.15000

**Calculation:**

A : B : C = 2x : 3x : 7x 

3x = 15000, x = 5000 

⇒ 7x - 3x = 4x = 4 × 5000 = 20000

**∴ The difference between the shares of B and C = Rs.20000**
